title: Item:The Shadowfell Conspiracy: Collector's Edition Claim Ticket
wikitext:
[[File:The Shadowfell Conspiracy Collector's Edition Claim Ticket.png|right]]
This item comes from obtaining the Collector's Edition of the [[Shadowfell Conspiracy]].

Using this item grants you a {{Item|Tome of Skill (+2)}} which will grant you any +2 {{Item|Tome of Skill}} except [[Use Magical Device]].
